recursive.description: Process the base folder as the recursive collection of Maildir folders.

backup_dir.description: Directory where deleted files are backed up. Empty string disables backup.

backup_tree.description: If set, deleted messages are moved to a Maildir folder tree inside the backup directory.

bzip2_path.description: Path to the bzip2 utility. Empty string uses PATH resolution.

gzip_path.description: Path to the gzip utility. Empty string uses PATH resolution.

maildirsync_bin.description: Path to the maildirsync.pl utility on the remote machine.

rsh_path.description: Path to the utility used to connect to the remote side.

destination_os.description: Transformation type for filenames: 'win' (colon to octal) or 'lin' (octal to colon). Empty means no transformation.

delete_before.description: Perform delete operations on the target side before transfers.

exclude_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to exclude directories from transfer and state file.

exclude_source_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to exclude files only from the source side.

exclude_target_patterns.description: List of regex patterns to exclude files only from the target side.

rename_expr.description: Perl expression for renaming files when transferred (e.g., s/Source/Target/).

state_file_path.description: Path to the state file storing synchronization status.
